info.name: Loan Lifecycle API
info.description:
**Lifecycle** matches **Swagger UI**, **`javascript/mock-server/openapi.json`**, and **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5** (happy path §**5.0**, production phase map §**5.4**). **OpenAPI 0.8.x** (see **`openapi.json`**) adds **GET /v1/health**, **GET /v1/reference/loan-products**, response headers **`X-Correlation-Id`** / **`X-Request-Id`**, optional **`Idempotency-Key`** on authenticated **POST**.

**Order (high level):** **Login** → **KYC** → **Create loan application** → **Documents** → (**optional:** **metrobank-deposit-account/confirm** when opening a Metrobank deposit for **ADA** — needed before **underwriting APPROVE**, not before **Submit**) → (**PEP Yes:** **compliance/pep-clearance**) → **Submit** → **Ops accept** → **Disclosures acknowledge** → Credit → **Start underwriting** → **Underwriting decision** → (optional **stipulations**) → **Funding authorize** → **Fund** (book) → **Disburse** → Get loan → Schedule → Payment(s) → Payoff → optional **Logout**.

**Personal Loan (DRAFT path):** optional **0a. Eligibility preview** → **1. Create** → **1b. Loan computation preview** → **1c. Register documents** (**`POST …/documents`**) → **1c-MB. Metrobank deposit confirm** (**`POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm`** when **`metrobank_client_type`** is **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`** and **`additional_information.metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan`** is **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`**) → **1d. PEP compliance clearance** (**`POST …/compliance/pep-clearance`** — **200** when Step **6** PEP is **Yes** on either question, **400** when both **No**; required before **2. Submit** if **Yes**) → **2. Submit**. Same operation IDs and paths as **Swagger** / **`openapi.json`**.

**ADA / Metrobank deposit:** **`{{metrobank_client_type}}`** defaults to **`EXISTING_CLIENT_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT`**. **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`** / **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** may **create** and **submit** without **1c-MB**; **`POST …/underwriting/decision`** (**APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL**) returns **422** until **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`** is set (e.g. via **1c-MB** while **DRAFT** with **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`**). See **`openapi.json` 0.8.15**.

**Tracing:** Collection **Pre-request** sets **`X-Correlation-Id`** (or **`correlation_id_override`** from the environment). **Tests** copy response **`X-Correlation-Id`** / **`X-Request-Id`** into **`last_correlation_id`** / **`last_request_id`**. **Idempotency:** set environment **`idempotency_key`** (any unique string); it is sent on **POST** requests as **`Idempotency-Key`** (clear it when you do not need deduplication).

**Production alignment:** Vocabulary follows common **LOS / origination + servicing** narratives; this is a **teaching sandbox**, not a full bank stack — see **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.4** for what real institutions add.

**Import-ready flow:** folder **Flow — Happy path (import & run in order)** (this guide §**7**).

**Stipulation tests:** **Tests — stipulations (single & multiple)** — Runner subfolders **A** (1 stip) and **B** (3 stips).

**Setup:** import **`postman/collection/Loan_Lifecycle_API.postman_collection.json`** and **`postman/environments/Local_Mock.postman_environment.json`** — select **Loan Lifecycle — Local mock**.

**OpenAPI / Swagger:** environment **`openapi_url`** and **`swagger_url`**, or import **`javascript/mock-server/openapi.json`** in Postman.

**Auth:** **`access_token`** from **Login**; collection Bearer except **Login** and **System & reference**. Password **`demo`** or **`demo123`**. **KYC** is required before **Create application** (**403** if skipped).

**URLs:** Use **`api_root`** for all **`/v1/...`** calls (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1`). Use **`base_url`** for **`/openapi.json`** and **`/docs`** only — do **not** put **`/v1`** in **`base_url`** or you will get **`/v1/v1/...`** and stray **401**s. **`npm run test:integration`** uses port **9876** — set **`base_url`**, **`api_root`**, **`openapi_url`**, and **`swagger_url`** accordingly.

request.description:
**GET /v1/reference/loan-computation-preview** — add-on interest, fees, net proceeds, EIR.

**Query (dynamic):** **`principal_cents`**, **`term_months`** — set environment **`loan_preview_principal_cents`** and **`loan_preview_term_months`** (or collection defaults). Allowed terms: **12, 18, 24, 36**.

**Why centavos?** The API stores money as **integer PHP centavos** (1 PHP = 100 centavos) so amounts stay exact — no floating-point rounding bugs in principal, fees, or amortization. Same pattern as many ledgers and payment APIs.

item.name: Flow — Happy path (import & run in order)
item.description: Same journey as **Swagger** operation order and **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.0**. Run **Collection Runner** on **this folder only** (top to bottom). Environment: **Loan Lifecycle — Local mock**. **Login** → **KYC** → optional **0a. Eligibility preview** → **1. Create** → **1b** → **1c** (**`{{primary_id_document_type}}`** on **`POST …/documents`**) → **1c-MB. Metrobank deposit confirm** — **Local mock** defaults to **no deposit yet** (**`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** + **`metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan_line`** for **`WILL_OPEN`** on **1. Create**; see §**7.3**). **200** after **1c**; **400** if env uses **`EXISTING_CLIENT_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT`** (confirm not applicable); **409** if plan missing / wrong or docs incomplete → **1d. PEP compliance clearance** (**200** or **400** when PEP both **No**) → **2. Submit** → numbered steps **3 … 14**; **15. Logout** is optional. Steps **1** (create) and **7** (underwriting) save **application_id** and **loan_id** via Tests. If step **7** is **CONDITIONAL**, it also sets **`stipulation_ids_json`** and **`stipulation_id`** — run **Fulfill all stipulations** in folder **Conditional — fulfill stipulations** once, then **9. Fund** (after **8. Funding — authorize**).

request.description: **After Step 7** when **Step 6 PEP** is **Yes** on either question: required before **2. Submit** (else **409**). If both PEP answers are **No**, returns **400** not required — Runner test accepts **200** or **400**.

Moves application to SUBMITTED. **1c-MB** is **not** required for submit; **underwriting APPROVE** still needs **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`** on **NOT** / **credit-card** paths. **PEP Yes:** run **1d** after **1c** (and after **1c-MB** if you ran it).
LOS-style: **SUBMITTED** → **IN_PROCESSING** (ops / processing queue).
Initial disclosure package acknowledged (sandbox gate before **credit-check**).
Sandbox credit step. Use `force_outcome`: PASS or FAIL, or `simulated_credit_score` (below 620 declines without force).
**CREDIT_COMPLETED** → **IN_UNDERWRITING** (underwriting queue) before **decision**.

Straight **APPROVE** → **PENDING_FUNDING** (no stips). For **CONDITIONAL**, replace body with `outcome` + `stipulations[]` — Tests save **`loan_id`**, **`stipulation_ids_json`** (all UUIDs), and the first open **`stipulation_id`**. Clear all stips in **one** call: **POST …/stipulations/fulfill-all** (folder **Conditional — fulfill stipulations**). Or fulfill one-by-one with **`{{stipulation_id}}`**. Empty **`stipulation_id`** yields `.../stipulations//fulfill` → **404**.
**PENDING_FUNDING** → **CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING** — production-style **clear-to-fund** before **GL** booking.
Books the loan: **CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING** → **FUNDED** (`funded_at`). Requires **8. Funding — authorize** first.
Sends proceeds to the borrower: **FUNDED** → **ACTIVE** (`disbursed_at`). Requires **9. Fund** first.
After **Disburse**, expect **`status`: ACTIVE** and **`balance_cents`** for repayments.
Illustrative amortization-style schedule from the mock (demo only).

Loan must be **ACTIVE** (run **10. Disburse** first). **`method`**: **ACH** (installments / NACHA-style) or **WIRE** (domestic wire / payoff-style). Set `payment_amount_cents`; use **Get loan** → `balance_cents` for a full payoff.
Closes the loan on the mock (**CLOSED**). Run after the loan is paid down or for demo teardown.
Invalidates **access_token** — you must **Login** again for further protected calls. Clears **access_token** in the active environment (if any) and collection.
